e1.text: (Name1), an elder, guides an apprentice through a difficult weaving pattern. A small mistake becomes a reason to try again, not a scolding.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, guides an apprentice through a difficult weaving pattern. The lesson lasts longer than planned because neither wants to stop.
